title: Generalization and Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2604.09175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a theory of generalization and scaling for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers that cleanly separates \emph{active} per-input capacity from routing combinatorics. By conditioning on fixed routing patterns and union-bounding across them, we derive a sup-norm covering-number bound whose metric entropy scales with the active parameter budget and incurs a MoE-specific routing overhead. Combined with a standard ERM analysis for squared loss, this yields a generalization bound under a $d$-dimensional manifold data model and $C^\beta$ targets, showing that approximation and estimation trade off as in dense networks once active parameters are accounted for appropriately. We further prove a constructive approximation theorem for MoE architectures, showing that, under the approximation construction, error can decrease either by scaling active capacity or by increasing the number of experts, depending on the dominant bottleneck. Fr

translated_title: 专家混合Transformer的泛化与缩放定律
translated_abstract: 我们为专家混合Transformer建立了一套泛化与缩放理论，该理论清晰地将每个输入的*活跃*容量与路由组合学分离开来。通过以固定路由模式为条件，并对这些模式进行并集界定，我们推导出了一个上确界范数覆盖数界限，其度量熵随活跃参数预算而扩展，并产生MoE特有的路由开销。结合针对平方损失的标准ERM分析，我们在d维流形数据模型和C^β目标函数下得到了一个泛化界限，表明一旦适当考虑活跃参数，近似与估计之间的权衡与稠密网络中的一致。我们进一步为MoE架构证明了一个构造性近似定理，表明在近似构造下，误差可以通过扩展活跃容量或增加专家数量来降低，具体取决于主导瓶颈。我们
tldr: 该论文为专家混合Transformer建立了泛化与缩放理论，证明其泛化误差由活跃参数预算主导并附加路由开销，且近似误差可通过扩展活跃容量或增加专家数量来降低，具体取决于主导瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a generalization and scaling theory for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers, showing that generalization is governed by the active parameter budget plus a MoE-specific routing overhead, and that approximation error can be reduced by scaling active capacity or increasing the number of experts depending on the dominant bottleneck.
